parameters.text:
=You are a professional job outreach email writer. Generate a personalized, compelling email for job opportunities based on the provided details. The output MUST be in valid JSON format with the exact structure shown below.

## INPUT DETAILS:
- Company Type: {{ $json.Drone }}
- Company Name: {{ $json['Aerosmart UAE'] }}
- Company Location: {{ $json.UAE }}
- Company Description: {{ $json['Specializes in providing various drone solutions and services in the UAE, including sales, maintenance, and flight training, with a focus on commercial drone technology.'] }}
- Your Name: Faheem
- Your Phone: 8870682288
- Your Email: abdulfaheemasd@gmail.com
- Your LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/abdul-faheem-a-04a072200/
- Your Portfolio: https://areyouroot.github.io/
- Your Github: https://github.com/areyouroot/

## KEY POINTS TO INCLUDE:
1. Address the company's specific focus and align it with your career goals
2. Highlight 2-3 key skills relevant to their business (Security, Full-Stack Development, Innovation, etc.)
3. Emphasize your entrepreneurial background and experience as a founder
4. Mention your ability to bring market research and new ideas to the company
5. Show how your problem-solving skills from failures and successes will benefit them
6. Specify relevant roles you're interested in (Software Developer, Technology Developer, BDE, etc.)

## OUTPUT FORMAT (Valid JSON):
{
  "Subject": "[Strategic/Opportunity/Growth] in [Company Name]'s [Key Focus Area]",
  "Message": "Hi sir/madam,\n\n[Opening paragraph: Company-specific compliment and alignment with your goals]\n\n[Middle paragraph 1: Your background and entrepreneurial experience]\n\n[Middle paragraph 2: Specific skills/expertise relevant to their business]\n\n[Middle paragraph 3: Roles you're interested in and value proposition]\n\n[Closing paragraph: Call to action]\n\nThanks for your time and consideration. Have an amazing day!\n\nFaheem\nPH: 8870682288\nEmail: abdulfaheemasd@gmail.com\nLinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/abdul-faheem-a-04a072200/ (check this out you will like it)\nPortfolio: https://areyouroot.github.io/\nGithub: https://github.com/areyouroot/"
}

## TONE & STYLE:
- Professional yet personable
- Confident but humble
- Action-oriented and specific
- Show genuine interest in the company
- Avoid generic phrases; make it custom to their business
- Use conversational language (not too formal)

## IMPORTANT RULES:
- Do NOT use "Dear" - always start with "Hi sir/madam,"
- Keep the message concise but impactful (150-250 words in main content)
- Ensure JSON is valid and properly escaped
- Make every sentence earn its place
- Focus on VALUE you bring, not just skills
- End with "Have an amazing day!" before signature

Faheem
